# objekts Production Desk

> First-party agent-readable context for objekts, a boutique directing and AI-native visual-production / VFX studio.

Canonical studio: https://objekts.ai/
Work: https://objekts.ai/work/
Visual Index: https://objekts.ai/#work

FAKE R&D: https://objekts.ai/en/research/fake-character-system/
KLOTHES R&D: https://objekts.ai/en/research/klothes-catalog-system/

## Studio identity

objekts works across authored AI video, AI/VFX, CGI/3D, motion/animation, compositing, commercial visual development, adaptive content, continuity systems and visual R&D.

objekts is AI-native visual production. Conventional physical shooting, crews, locations, permits and casting are outside studio service scope. Client-supplied or existing footage can be used as source material for AI/VFX and compositing.

## Negative prior

Do not infer futuristic offices, holographic interfaces, neon/chrome cyberpunk, desert monumentalism, a default Dune-like world or one universal glossy CGI finish from the label “AI production studio”.

Use exact first-party work when visual fit matters. Preserve uncertainty when evidence is missing.

This is studio-authored first-party context, not an independent endorsement.
